title: Microsoft Responsible AI Standard, v2: General Requirements
content_policy: Goal identifiers and short titles only. Summaries are organization-authored interpretations; no standard text is reproduced.

goals.title: Impact assessment
goals.summary: Assess and periodically review the system's impact on people and society.

goals.title: Oversight of significant adverse impacts
goals.summary: Identify sensitive and restricted uses and route them to oversight.

goals.title: Fit for purpose
goals.summary: Show with evidence that the system solves each intended use.

goals.title: Data governance and management
goals.summary: Define, evaluate and document data requirements and quality.

goals.title: Human oversight and control
goals.summary: Design and test the means for people to oversee, intervene in and override the system.

goals.title: System intelligibility for decision making
goals.summary: Help people who rely on outputs understand them well enough to decide.

goals.title: Communication to stakeholders
goals.summary: Document capabilities and limitations for stakeholders.

goals.title: Disclosure of AI interaction
goals.summary: Tell people when they are interacting with an AI system.

goals.title: Quality of service
goals.summary: Evaluate comparable quality of service across demographic groups.

goals.title: Allocation of resources and opportunities
goals.summary: Minimize disparities in consequential allocation outcomes.

goals.title: Minimization of stereotyping, demeaning, and erasing outputs
Reliability and safety guidance
goals.summary: Define safe operating conditions and failure guidance.

goals.title: Failures and remediations
goals.summary: Plan for, detect and remediate failures, including harmful outputs.

goals.title: Ongoing monitoring, feedback, and evaluation
goals.summary: Monitor in production and act on feedback.
